component.name: Bootcade
component.summary: Native GTK launcher and ROM manager for FinalBurn Neo

description.p: A lightweight, native GUI for FinalBurn Neo on Linux. Browse a 25,000-game collection instantly, verify every set against the official DAT files, and launch straight into the emulator : no terminal required.
Library

ul.li: List and cover-grid views with instant search and lazy loading
Stackable filters: system, release type, year, manufacturer, status
Favourites, play tracking and automatic artwork download

description.p: ROM management

ul.li: CRC32 verification of every ROM against FinalBurn Neo DAT files
Library audit showing exactly which set is broken and which file is at fault
Inbox to outbox rebuilder: repairs incomplete sets from pieces found in your downloads and in your existing library, without ever writing to it
Reads zip, 7z, rar and tar archives; always writes clean ZIP sets
